__inputs.name: VAR_DEFAULT_CPU_FREQUENCY_MEGA_HERTZ
__inputs.label: default_cpu_frequency_mega_hertz
__inputs.description: Used this frequency when node_cpu_frequency_hertz is not available when  BIOS/UEFI Power supply profil is _Static High_ Performance_ or _Maximum Performance_

options.content:
Virtual Machine
$vm
$namespace

targets.expr:
sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m])) 
* 
(
  sum(avg(node_cpu_frequency_hertz{instance="$node"})) 
)
or
sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m])) 
* 
(
  (sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m])) * 0 + ($default_cpu_frequency_mega_hertz*1000000))
) or vector(0)

max(
  label_replace(
    (
      sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_read_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
      /
      sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
    ) * 1000,
    "type", "read", "", ""
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    (
      sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_write_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
      /
      sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
    ) * 1000,
    "type", "write", "", ""
  )
) or on() vector(0)

(
    sum (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_read_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[5m]))
    /
    sum (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[5m]))
  ) *1000 or on() vector(0)

(
    sum (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_write_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
    /
    sum (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
  )*1000 or on() vector(0)

(
  (
    sum by (drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_read_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
    /
    sum by (drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
  ) *1000 or (avg_over_time(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1h]) * 0)
)

(
  (
    sum by (drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_write_times_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
    /
    sum by (drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1m]))
  )*1000 or (avg_over_time(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace="$namespace", name="$vm"}[1h]) * 0)
)

list.description: Used this frequency when node_cpu_frequency_hertz is not available when  BIOS/UEFI supply profil is _Static High_ Performance_ or _Maximum Performance_
list.name: default_cpu_frequency_mega_hertz
